query:element_type_count.answer_hint: set "answer" to the number of counted surface elements
query:element_type_count.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array containing one [x, y] pixel point near the center of each counted surface element

query:highest_element_count_panel.answer_hint: set "answer" to the selected panel label as a single capital letter
query:highest_element_count_panel.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array containing one [x0, y0, x1, y1] pixel box around the selected panel

query:lowest_element_count_panel.answer_hint: set "answer" to the selected panel label as a single capital letter
query:lowest_element_count_panel.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array containing one [x0, y0, x1, y1] pixel box around the selected panel

query:element_color_count.answer_hint: set "answer" to the count as an integer
query:element_color_count.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array containing one [x, y] pixel point near the center of each counted colored surface element

query:scoped_element_color_count.answer_hint: set "answer" to the count as an integer
query:scoped_element_color_count.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array containing one [x, y] pixel point near the center of each counted colored surface element in the requested row or column

query:empty_or_missing_cell_count.answer_hint: set "answer" to the count as an integer
query:empty_or_missing_cell_count.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array containing one [x, y] pixel point near the center of each missing fixture position
